analysis.visual_description: On the board. The first line still there. Under it, a new line in a smaller hand. The smear of the last try is at the edge.
On the board. The two plain lines. He has not written a cup, a vial, or a drink. The bundle is still a red knot at the side.
On the board. The stylus lifted. The page is those two lines and nothing under them. One candle.
